title: Foo Fighters drawn to WWII atomic and military programs
summary: Lou Elizondo tells of Foo Fighters drawn to WWII atomic and military programs, about 1944-1945 at Southern Germany, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: During World War II, around 1944 and 1945 over southern Germany, aircrews reported strange glowing objects they called foo fighters. Lou Elizondo, a well-known voice on UFOs, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that today's unidentified objects (which officials call UAP, unidentified anomalous phenomena) seem interested in nuclear and military capabilities. He suggests the foo fighters appeared because of what was going on at the height of the war, which would mean these objects have been watching human weapons for a long time.
